info.title: estimate_run_rate_extras
info.description: Run-rate lines beyond compute and storage — Azure Backup (vault storage + protected-instance fees), internet egress (from net_out_gb_30d), monitoring (Log Analytics ingestion + Defender for Servers), and a support plan — plus the one-time cost of the migration itself (Azure Migrate / ASR tooling after its free window, replication egress, and dual-running on-prem + Azure during cutover). Deterministic; every rate from estimation_config.json ["extras"]. Excludes ExpressRoute/VPN, landing-zone fixed services, and DB compute.

post.summary: Run-rate extras (backup / egress / monitoring / support) + one-time migration cost
post.description: Pass the servers (used_disk_gb or provisioned_disk_gb, net_out_gb_30d, powerstate) and monthly_infra_cost (the compute + storage totals from estimate_compute_cost + estimate_storage_cost, used for the dual-run one-time line). Returns run_rate_monthly (with a per-line breakdown), one_time, and totals including first_year_extras. Quote the assumptions.

monthly_infra_cost.description: compute + storage monthly total; drives the dual-run one-time line
